purpose: Held-out validation of a fail-closed first-party NFL NGS exact-name-plus-team resolver from frozen official-club roster metadata to candidate GSIS identifiers. This experiment tests deterministic operational resolution only; it does not establish independent semantic ground truth, injury availability, player value, forecast effect, model fit, or production authority.

target_selection.source: Only the pinned official_club_roster_v2 roster_metadata.jsonl above.
target_selection.name_normalization: Unicode NFKD; encode ASCII with non-ASCII combining/content dropped; lowercase; replace each maximal run of non-[a-z0-9] with one space; trim; collapse whitespace. Token order is preserved and suffix tokens are not removed.

coverage_stratum.rule: For each of the 32 teams in lexicographic team order, sort eligible non-sentinel rows by selection_key SHA-256 ascending, then visible_name ascending, then profile_path ascending; take exactly the first 2 rows.

source_name_ambiguity_stratum.rule: Among all eligible non-sentinel source rows, group by normalized visible_name. Include every row in every group represented on more than one distinct team. Do not select or rank ambiguity groups using NGS data.

target_selection.union_rule: Take the row-identity union of coverage_stratum and source_name_ambiguity_stratum keyed by team, visible_name, and profile_path.

request.query_string_source: exact official-club visible_name from frozen target row
request.transport_retry_policy: At most 2 additional attempts of the identical URL only for network timeout, HTTP 429, or HTTP 5xx. Zero-result, malformed semantic content, or ambiguity must not trigger alternate queries.
request.required_success_shape: HTTP 200 JSON object containing a players array

fixed_query_and_resolution_rule.candidate_team_match: strip(players[].teamAbbr).upper() must equal strip(target.team).upper() exactly; no team alias substitution
fixed_query_and_resolution_rule.selected_candidate_rule: Exactly one response candidate must satisfy both candidate_name_match and candidate_team_match, and its gsisId must match ^00-[0-9]{7}$. Zero or multiple matching candidates are unresolved.

jersey.official_value: integer-normalized target.jersey_number when nonempty and parseable
jersey.ngs_value: integer-normalized selected candidate uniformNumber, else jerseyNumber, when nonempty and parseable

authority_if_any_v2_gate_fails.required_next_action: Freeze the failed first result; any revised resolver, threshold, selection rule, source, or retry behavior must be a new version.

governance.next_phase_after_pass: Separately preregister a held-out PIT inactive/availability identity application. V2 itself cannot authorize availability, player-value joins, forecast effects, model fitting, or production.
